variants.label: Flex
variants.tooltip: A flexible container providing an efficient way to align and distribute space among components, particularly when their size is unknown or dynamic.

variants.label: Row
variants.tooltip: A flexible container providing an efficient way to align and distribute space among components, particularly when their size is unknown or dynamic.

variants.label: Column
variants.tooltip: A flexible container providing an efficient way to align and distribute space among components, particularly when their size is unknown or dynamic.

wrap.description: Whether the container should allow children to wrap to next line if space has run out.

justify.description: Adjusts placement of children along the main axis when there is extra space, which may be used to fill areas before, after or in-between.

alignItems.description: Adjusts placement of children along the cross axis when there is extra space.

alignContent.description: Adjusts alignment of wrapped content when there is free space in the cross axis.

grow.description: Ability to grow in 'direction' dimension as needed, relative to siblings. If space is available and grow is not zero, it may stretch, depending on sibling rules.

shrink.description: Ability to shrink in 'direction' dimension as needed, relative to siblings. If space is available and shrink is not zero, it may be compressed, depending on sibling rules.

basis.description: Space filled by component by default, before 'grow', 'shrink' and sibling considerations are evaluated. It's the component's base width, if 'direction' is 'row', or 'height' if 'column'.

align.description: Allow a single flex child to position itself along the cross-axis (Ex: If layout direction is 'row', this adjusts 'y' relatively).

display.description: If false, this child will be excluded from flex container layout
